description: Long and narrow and organised to within an inch of its life. Rods racked vertically on the left wall by length, reels in a locked case, and on the right a wall of small drawers, each labelled, holding hooks and swivels and weights down to sizes that seem theoretical. The bait fridge hums at the back beside a sink with a tidemark. It smells of cold water, old rope and, underneath that, of a fridge that has held bait for a long time.

window.description: Nine rods stood upright in a rank with their tips against the glass, and behind them a whiteboard facing out with the week's water written on it. Past the rods, the road, and the statue with its back to you.
window.name: the rod window
